tools.name: find_venues
tools.description: Search and filter verified Gauteng event and celebration venues (weddings, baby showers, birthdays, year-end, corporate, private celebrations) by event type, location/suburb, guest capacity, layout setting, and budget envelope. Returns up to 10 curated venues with unedited Google ratings and pricing

tools.name: get_venue_details
tools.description: Retrieve comprehensive details, description, amenities, unedited Google star rating, guest capacity, pricing structure, and contact coordinates for a specific venue by slug or ID.

tools.name: check_venue_availability
tools.description: Check live venue capacity suitability, per-person catering rates, base venue hire fees, layout options, and quote availability for a specific venue or celebration criteria in Gauteng.

tools.name: request_curated_quotes
tools.description: Submit a consolidated rate & availability request for up to 3 shortlisted Gauteng venues. Alerts the venue coordinators directly via email/WhatsApp, creates an escrow quote review session, and returns the actionable client review URL (https://arranged.co.za/quotes?token=...).

tools.name: check_quote_status
tools.description: Check real-time status and confirmed rates for an existing 3-venue quote request using the client token.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Return authenticated profile or environment identity for the Arranged platform.
